title: feat(letbits): 16 letterings: N_Rev=4 N_Face=4 N_both=1
science: Near-vacuous and terminologically corrosive. It redefines 'reverse' as the predicate L(A)=+ and L(B)=- and 'face' as L(C)=+ and L(D)=- on sign-letterings of four sites, then counts N_Rev=4, N_Face=4, N_both=1 over 2^4=16 maps. Each count is the triviality 2^(4-2)=4 with two constrained bits; the joint count is forced by independence of the two site pairs. No arrival, tick, or lattice computation o
verdict_pair: reverse=N_Rev=4 of 16 letterings, face=N_Face=4, both=1 -- l
